description: 2009 Malawi Earthquake RAMP Response is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by International Federation of Digital Seismograph Networks. Deployment of five temporary broadband stations in the Karonga region of northern Malaiwi, to record aftershocks from the 2009 sequence of damaging Mw 5.8-6.0 events. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher International Federation of Digital Seismograph Networks. The repository dates the deposit 2010; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
